comment: Metadata the EUDI rules add and OpenID4VCI does not define: credential_metadata.credential_reuse_policy (ARF ISSU_39, TS 119 472-3 §4.2.4), issuer_info (TS 119 472-3 §4.2.3) and each claim's value_type. The suite's schema closes credential_metadata, so the first fails the whole configuration branch and the schema then reports its standard members (scope, proof_types_supported, cryptographic_binding_methods_supported) as unknown too.

cunho signs its status list tokens with an x5c chain, as HAIP and TS3 have it. The plan for the pre-authorized flow runs the suite's plain OpenID4VCI profile, which checks that signature only against an embedded jwk or the authorization server's jwks; the HAIP plans check the same tokens against the x5c chain and pass.

Each mdoc of a batch carries its own document_number in org.iso.23220.1: ETSI TS 119 472-1 EAA-6.2.3-01 makes it the attestation's unique identifier, and cunho draws it at random for each attestation (128 bits, PRIV.UNIQUE_ELEMENTS_CSPRNG), as it does salts and status indexes, so the copies of a batch cannot be linked by it when presented to different relying parties, which is what a batch is for. The subject's data elements are the same in every copy, as the suite's own comparison shows.
